messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Serving queue for model-redwood/gpt-large exceeded threshold in us-west-2. Pending requests: ~12k, mean queue latency 21s. Autoscaler attempted 3x scale-ups but hit region quota/scale limit. Multiple nodes reporting CUDA Xid 13 / OOM during warmup. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/r/abc123 (pager)
rohan: on-call rohan here — I'm triaging. any customer-facing errors showing?
mia: seeing 500s and timeouts in the hosted API traces, primarily tail latency spikes when requests hit nodes that flapped. Error sample: `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS (Xid 13)` in driver logs.
rohan: copy. ops-bot, can you post autoscaler events and current pool sizes?
ops-bot: Autoscaler events: 
- 2024-06-01T17:14Z scale up requested +50 GPUs
- Rate limit: API quota 0/50 (region commit limit)
- 3 nodes failed to register due to driver crashes
Current pools: gpu-pool-west: 120 GPUs (effective 110 due to failing nodes)
queue depth: 12,340
rohan: thanks. quick plan: 1) reduce incoming pressure (throttle non-critical routes), 2) divert traffic to eu-west-1 if possible, 3) kill/fence flapping nodes to restore healthy capacity, 4) fallback to smaller quantized model for low-priority requests.
sam: I'm toggling the feature-flag that routes low-priority requests to `gpt-qa-quant` now (will take ~30s). Will post when done.
lina: I'm preparing the node fencing list. which nodes are flapping? logs show GPU nodes: gpu-ww-07, gpu-ww-12, gpu-ww-19 with repeated Xid entries.
mia: confirmed. sample driver snippet: ```
[driver] 17:16:02 ERROR cuda: Xid 13 detected - illegal memory access
[model-serving] trace_id=af4c... payload_size=12k tokens model=gpt-large
OOM during KV cache warmup, stacktrace attached to node logs
```
rohan: fencing command (run on infra-admin): ```
sudo /opt/infra/bin/fence-node --node gpu-ww-07 --reason "Xid 13 flapping"
kubectl cordon gpu-ww-07 && kubectl drain gpu-ww-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
rohan: mia, can you check if driver 525.60 has a regression vs 520.? might need rollback.
mia: quick grep shows 525.60 rollout yesterday to 40% of west pool. I'll push a rollback to 520.78 on the failing ASG.
sam: feature-flag switch completed: low-priority route now hitting gpt-qa-quant, which is reducing queued low-priority requests by ~4.5k. queue now 7.8k.
ops-bot: autoscaler still blocked by region quota. We can request emergency quota bump but lead time uncertain. Alternative: shift jobs to dedicated-reserved-pool in us-east-1 (has 80 spare GPUs).
rohan: initiate cross-region routing for burst traffic. sam, can you flip the routing lambda to send excess to us-east-1? quick config: `max_queue_threshold=2000 => route_to_east=true`
sam: deploying routing change now. will monitor.
lina: fencing completed for gpu-ww-07 and gpu-ww-12. gpu-ww-19 still unstable, isolating next.
mia: driver rollback to 520.78 started on the remaining 3 suspect nodes in west. rolling restarts in progress.
sre-lead: customer impact note: Hosted API error rate up to 14% for us-west-2 over the past 18m; customers using long-context models most affected. No payment/platform-wide outage, but higher latencies and errors for a subset of requests. Please populate incident doc with impacted customers and times.
rohan: creating incident doc -> https://incidents.internal/INC-2024-145 (added initial timeline + affected models).
ops-bot: routing change result: approx 5.6k requests diverted to us-east-1. west queue now 2.3k. overall system tail latency improving.
sam: note: we had to reduce batch size on the fallback model to avoid mem spikes: `batch_size: 16 -> 8` and enable prefix cache TTL 30s to reduce KV warmups.
lina: next steps for oncall handoff: 1) confirm all flapping nodes fenced, 2) confirm driver rollout complete and stable for 15m, 3) get autoscaler quota request submitted to cloud-ops. I've started a quota request: ticket CLOUD-7892.
mia: logs show last Xid 13 on gpu-ww-19 at 17:42Z, then driver restart, no further Xids for 10m.
rohan: handing off to @lina for next 8h. summary: queue surge due to regional quota + driver regressions causing effective GPU loss; immediate mitigations: reroute low-priority traffic, fence flapping nodes, rollback driver, divert burst to us-east-1, reduce batch sizes on fallback. Outstanding: cloud quota bump, root cause of driver regression, follow up with driver team.
lina: taking over. I'm paging driver-team and cloud-ops for CR follow-up. tagging @sre-lead for postmortem.
sam: I'll keep the routing lambda on and monitor traffic; will revert once west is <500 pending.
rohan: thx team. if anything spikes, @lina will be primary. I'll be reachable if needed.
ops-bot: Incident status changed: Mitigated -> Partial (service degraded). Updated at 2024-06-01T18:03Z.
sre-lead: please add impacted customers and any billing/credit notes to the incident doc. create short customer comms draft (we'll iterate).
lina: noted. creating action items: ACTION-1: driver rollback verification (mia), ACTION-2: quota follow-up (rohan/cloud-ops), ACTION-3: postmortem + customer comms (sre-lead).
mia: verification: driver rollback completed on all targeted nodes; monitoring for 30m window. Initial metrics look stable.
rohan: closing paging loop. last check: west queue 420, error rate back to baseline 1.2%. handing full ownership to lina for post-incident tasks.
lina: acknowledged. I'll post a summary in #incidents after we collect logs and timelines. :white_check_mark:
